description: SeedRay is a Seed-Xray mod that bypasses anti-xray plugins by using the seed worldgen math to simulate ore positions on your client, revealing the positions of ores with devastatingly high accuracy. Please credit if you decide to use this mod somewhere (video, hacked client), a simple named mention is enough. (.jar is under dist)

mods.name: Seed X-Ray Test Tool
mods.description: Client-side seed-based ore prediction and PaperMC anti-xray diagnostic visualization for authorized test servers.
